what: Card cells that stick at the same height (135px) cover the previous cell in turn — until the cell top touches the 75% screen line and sticks, the card tilts 0°·4°·−4° in turn with a power1.in scrub. At the moment of sticking it stretches horizontally by 1.5× the glyph width and squashes vertically by a third (.1s power1.out), then bounces like jelly with elastic.out(1, .3) over 1s

options.rotate: Tilt per slot (degrees), comma-separated, default 0,4,-4 — repeats if fewer than the slot count
options.stretch: Horizontal stretch amount at the moment of sticking (multiple of card font size), default 1.5 — 0 means no stretch
options.squash: Amount to squash vertically (multiple of the stretched amount), default .33

from.where: index.html reasons card stack (.b-why__list) — original initStackingStickyCardsBounce
